message: `axiom_alloc` is the emitted runtime's allocator symbol; a program cannot define it
label: this name belongs to the runtime
notes: the backend emits its own definition of `axiom_alloc` unconditionally; before this refusal the build died in `opt` as a duplicate symbol after `check` said OK
help: rename the function - the override seam does not exist (docs/memory-model.md MM-ALLOC-8)
